note: These are small prompt contracts for trigger, negative-trigger, and conflict review. Static checks validate the cases and declarations; only runtime smoke tests assess actual provider activation.

positive.prompt: Audit the Supabase RLS policies and auth posture before release.
Should 'account' mean the company or the signed-in user? Update the glossary decision.
Redesign this module interface to hide complexity and improve testability.
Implement this approved behavior using red-green-refactor.
Review the changes since main against the issue and repo standards.
This endpoint intermittently returns the wrong result; diagnose the root cause first.
Prepare a standalone handoff for another agent to resume this branch.
Create a landing page; explore and compare visual directions before coding.
The brand direction is approved; define the reusable color, type, spacing, and component rules.
Find every call site and import of normalizeContact before a refactor.
The active context is huge and conflicting; keep only what is needed and retrieve details later.
Create a new HGA skill and test its triggers, non-triggers, overlaps, and examples.

negative.prompt: Read the existing glossary to learn what 'account' means; do not change it.
Implement the already-approved UI mockup without changing its visual direction.
The function is broken; locate the root cause before proposing a fix.
Summarize the current thread in place because context is noisy; do not create a handoff file.
Create a project architecture plan for the new module boundary.
Check whether this diff follows the issue and project standards.

conflicts.prompt: Find usages of this function and then refactor its interface.
conflicts.rule: Search/impact inventory first; architecture and tests only own their distinct follow-up steps.

conflicts.prompt: Find the cause of this bug and implement a regression fix.
conflicts.rule: Diagnosis/reproduction first; transition to TDD after root cause and correct seam are known.

conflicts.prompt: Make this new landing page consistent with our brand system.
conflicts.rule: Direction discovery/approval first; system materialization and implementation follow.

conflicts.prompt: Summarize a long session so another agent can continue tomorrow.
conflicts.rule: The requested standalone transfer artifact belongs to handoff; context engineering contributes safe compression/retrieval principles only.
